እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የአቤሜሌክ ልጅ አብያታር ወደ ዳዊት ወደ ቂአላ በኰበለለ ጊዜ ኤፉዱን ይዞ ወርዶ ነበር።
ለሳኦልም ዳዊት ወደ ቂአላ እንደ መጣ ተነገረው፤ ሳኦልም፥ “መዝጊያና መወርወሪያ ወዳለባት ከተማ ገብቶ ተገኝቶአልና እግዚአብሔር በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶታል” አለ።
ሳኦልም ወደ ቂአላ ወርደው ይዋጉ ዘንድ፥ ዳዊትንና ሰዎቹንም ይከብቡ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ አዘዘ።
ዳዊትም ሳኦል በእርሱ ለክፋት ዝም እንደማይል ዐወቀ፤ ዳዊትም ካህኑን አብያታርን፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን ኤፉድ ወደዚህ አምጣ” አለው።
ዳዊትም፥ “የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ! በእኔ ምክንያት ከተማዪቱን ያጠፋ ዘንድ ሳኦል ወደ ቂአላ ሊመጣ እንደሚፈልግ እኔ ባሪያህ ፈጽሜ ሰምቻለሁ።
"Will the men of Keilah honor me? Will your servant Saul truly descend as he has heard?" said the Lord God, "He shall descend."
And David said, "Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the Lord God answered, "They will deliver you."
And David and six hundred men arose and departed from Keilah; and they followed where they were to go. And Saul was informed that David had escaped from Keilah; therefore he refrained from going out.
And David dwelt in the wilderness in the strongholds, and he remained in the mountain of Ziph, in the wilderness; and Saul sought him every day, but God did not deliver him into his hand.
And when Saul sought him, David was seen in the wilderness of Ziph, in the wood of Keilah.
And the son of Saul, Jonathan, arose and went to David in the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
And he said to him, "Fear not, for the hand of my father Saul shall not find you; and you shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you; and my father Saul knows this."
And they both made a covenant before the Lord; and David remained in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
And the Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Behold, David is hiding himself with us in the strongholds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the right hand of Jeshimon."
Now therefore, O king! If you desire to come down, come down; for it is in the king's hand to deliver us."
And Saul said, "You have lamented for me; therefore, be blessed in the sight of the Lord."
"Now therefore, go and prepare yourselves; be swift, lest you be caught in the places where you have spoken."
"Henceforth, know this: after your elders, we shall go with you; and in that land, I shall surely smite all the inhabitants of Judah."
And the men of Ziph arose and went before Saul; but David and his men remained in the wilderness of Maon, on the right side of the desert.
And Saul and his men went to seek him; and they told David; and he went down into the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued David into the wilderness of Maon.

And Saul and his men went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men went on the other side of the mountain. And David was hurrying to get away from Saul, for Saul and his men were closing in on David and his men to capture them.
And a messenger came to Saul, saying, "The Philistines have invaded the land; make haste to come."
And Saul returned to pursue David, for he went to engage with the Philistines. Therefore, that place was called the Rock of Escape.

sections.title: And David's lamentation over Saul.

verses.text: And David arose and took his stand in a place near the eye of the fountain;
And Saul, after returning from pursuing the Philistines, said, “Behold! David is in the wilderness of Engedi,” thus they spoke.
And Saul gathered three thousand chosen men from all Israel, and went to seek David and his men in the rocks of the wild goats.
And he came to the sheepfolds by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet. Now David and his men were sitting in the inner recesses of the cave.

And the men of David said to him, “Behold, the day of which the Lord said to you, ‘I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it seems good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the edge of Saul's robe secretly.
And afterward, David's heart struck him because he had cut off the edge of Saul's robe.
And David said to his men, “The Lord forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the Lord’s anointed, to put out my hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.”
So David persuaded his men with these words and did not permit them to attack Saul. And Saul arose from the cave and went on his way.
Afterward, David also arose and went out of the cave and called after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth and paid homage.
And David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you?’”

Behold, today the Lord God has delivered me into your hand, as you have said; your eyes shall not see me, for men have spoken against me to lead you astray; but I said, "As the Lord lives, I will not stretch forth my hand against my lord, for he is the Lord's anointed."

Behold, consider that the hem of your garment is in my hand; I did not cut off your hem, and therefore, know this: there is no evil or transgression in my hand, and I have not sinned against you; yet you seek my life to take it away.
May the Lord judge between you and me, and may the Lord avenge me on you; but my hand shall not be against you.
As the ancient proverb says, "Out of the wicked comes forth wickedness," yet my hand shall not be against you.
Now, whom do you pursue, O king of Israel? Whom do you chase? A dead dog? Or a flea?
Therefore, let the Lord be the judge; let Him decide between you and me; and let Him see and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.
Thus it came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

And Saul said to David, "I have sinned; return, my son David, for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your sight this day. Indeed, I have played the fool and erred exceedingly."
And the Lord has delivered me today into your hand, and you did not kill me; for if I had done good to you, let it be known to me what you have done.
Who is the man that finds his enemy and sends him away in a good way? Therefore, for the kindness you have shown me, may the Lord return to you the good you have done.
And now, behold, I know that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.
Now therefore, I pray you, do not let my name be cut off from the house of my father, nor let it be blotted out before the Lord.
And David spoke to Saul; and Saul went to his house, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

sections.title: The Death of the Prophet Samuel

verses.text: And Samuel died; and all Israel gathered together and mourned for him, and they buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose and went down to the wilderness of Maon.

sections.title: Concerning David and Nabal.

verses.text: በማዖንም የተቀመጠ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ ከብቱም በቀርሜሎስ ነበረ፤ እጅግም ታላቅ ሰው ነበረ፤ ለእርሱም ሦስት ሺህ በጎችና አንድ ሺህ ፍየሎች ነበሩት፤ በቀርሜሎስም በጎቹን ሊሸልት ሄደ።
የሰውዬውም ስም ናባል፥ የሚስቱም ስም አቤግያ ነበረ፤ ሴቲቱም ደግና ብልህ፥ መልክዋም እጅግ የተዋበ ነበረ፤ ሰውዬው ግን ጨካኝና ንፉግ ነበረ፤ ግብሩም ክፉ ነበረ።
ዳዊትም በምድረ በዳ ሳለ፥ “ናባል በቀርሜሎስ በጎቹን ይሸልታል” የሚል ወሬ ሰማ።
ዳዊትም ዐሥር ብላቴኖችን ላከ፤ ለብላቴኖቹም አለ፥ “ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ወጥታችሁ ወደ ናባል ሂዱ፤ በስሜም ሰላም በሉት፤
እንዲህም በሉት፥ “ደኅንነትና ሰላም ለአንተና ለቤትህ፥ ለአንተም ለሆኑት ሁሉ ይሁን።
አሁንም በጎችህ እንደሚሸለቱ ከእኛ ጋር በምድረ በዳ ያሉ ሰዎች ነገሩን፤ እኛም አልከለከልናቸውም፤ በቀርሜሎስም በነበሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ ከመንጋቸው ይሰጡን ዘንድ አላዘዝናቸውም።
ብላቴኖችህን ጠይቃቸው፤ እነርሱም ይነግሩሃል፤ አሁንም እንግዲህ በመልካም ቀን መጥተናልና ብላቴኖች በፊትህ ሞገስ ያግኙ፤ በእጅህም ከተገኘው ለልጅህ ለዳዊት እባክህ፥ ላክ።”
የዳዊትም ብላቴኖች መጡ፤ ይህንም የላካቸውን ቃል ሁሉ በዳዊት ስም ለናባል ነገሩት፤
ናባልም ተነሥቶ ለዳዊት ብላቴኖች መለሰላቸው እንዲህም አላቸው፥ “ዳዊት ማን ነው? የእሴይስ ልጅ ማን ነው? እያንዳንዳቸው ከጌቶቻቸው የኰበለሉ አገልጋዮች ዛሬ ብዙ ናቸው።
እንጀራዬንና የወይን ጠጄን፥ ለሸላቾቼም ያረድሁትን ሥጋ ወስጄ ከወዴት እንደ ሆኑ ለማላውቃቸው ሰዎች እሰጣለሁን?”
And the men of David, having gathered, returned by the way they came; and they told David all these things.

And David said to the men, “Let each of you gird on your sword.” And every man girded on his sword; and David also girded on his sword. And about four hundred men followed David, and two hundred remained with the baggage.
And one of the young men told Abigail, the wife of Nabal, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our lord; and he scorned them.”
But these men were very rude to us, and we were not harmed; and during the time we were in the fields with them, we were not given anything by them.
And we were with them in the wilderness, and they were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the time we were with them keeping the sheep.

Therefore, it has been reported to our lord that evil should not come upon him and his house, for he is a wicked man, and no one can speak to him; therefore, consider what you will do, for evil is determined against our lord and against all his household.”

And Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, and two skins of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of roasted grain, and a hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.
And she said to her servants, “Go on before me; behold, I am coming after you.” But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
And as she rode on the donkey, and came down under cover of the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.
Now David said, “Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that belonged to him; and he has returned me evil for good.”
If it be that he is a scoundrel, let it be said until the morning that one who is caught in sin, may the Lord do thus to David, and may He add thus also.
And when Abigail saw David, she hurried and descended; and she fell before David on her face; and the earth also trembled beneath her.
And she fell at his feet, and said, "My lord! Let this iniquity be upon me; let your maidservant speak in your hearing, and hear the words of your maidservant."

I beseech you, let not my lord's heart be troubled by this wicked man; for as his name is, so is he; his name is Nabal; and he is as his name; but I, your maidservant, have not seen the young men whom you sent.

Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I pray you, let not the innocent blood be shed, and let not your hand be against your servant; and let all your adversaries and those who seek evil against my lord be as Nabal.
Now let this present which your maidservant has brought to my lord be given to the young men who follow my lord.

For the Lord will certainly make a house for my lord, because my lord is fighting the battles of the Lord; and may my iniquity be forgiven, I pray you, for in all your days may no evil be found in you.

And if a man rises to pursue you and to seek your life, then the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living with the Lord your God; but the lives of your enemies He shall sling out, as from the pocket of a sling.
And it shall come to pass, when the Lord has done for my lord according to all the good that He has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you ruler over Israel,

that this will be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. But when the Lord has dealt well with my lord, then remember your maidservant."
ዳዊትም አቤግያን አላት፥ “ዛሬ እኔን ለመገናኘት አንቺን የላከ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።
ጠባይሽ የተባረከ ነው። ወደ ደም እንዳልገባ፥ እጄንም እንዳድን ዛሬ የከለከልሽኝ አንቺም የተባረክሽ ነሽ።
ነገር ግን ክፉ እንዳላደርግብሽ የከለከለኝ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እኔን ለመገናኘት ፈጥነሽ ባልመጣሽ ኖሮ፥ እስኪነጋ ድረስ ለናባል አጥር ተጠግቶ የሚሸን አንድ ስንኳ ባልቀረውም ብዬ ነበር።”
ዳዊትም ያመጣችውን ከእጅዋ ተቀብሎ፥ “በሰላም ወደ ቤትሽ ሂጂ፤ እነሆ፥ ቃልሽን እንደ ሰማሁ፥ ፊትሽንም እንዳከበርሁ ተመልከቺ” አላት።
አቤግያም ወደ ናባል መጣች፤ እነሆም፥ በቤቱ እንደ ንጉሥ ግብዣ ያለ ግብዣ ያደርግ ነበር፤ ናባልም እጅግ ሰክሮ ነበርና ልቡ ደስ ብሎት ነበር፤ ስለዚህም እስኪነጋ ድረስ ታናሽ ነገር ወይም ታላቅ ነገር አልነገረችውም ነበር።
በነጋውም የወይኑ ስካር ከናባል ባለፈ ጊዜ ሚስቱ ይህን ነገር ነገረችው፤ ልቡም በውስጡ ሞተ፤ እንደ ድንጋይም ሆነ፤
ከዐሥር ቀንም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ናባልን ቀሠፈው፤ እርሱም ሞተ።
ዳዊትም ናባል እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ “ከናባል እጅ የስድቤን ፍርድ የፈረደልኝ፥ ባሪያውንም ከክፉዎች እጅ የጠበቀ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን፤ እግዚአብሔርም የናባልን ክፋት በራሱ ላይ መለሰ” አለ። ዳዊትም ያገባት ዘንድ አቤግያን እንዲያነጋግሩለት ላከ።
የዳዊትም ብላቴኖች ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ወደ አቤግያ መጡ፥ “ዳዊትም ሚስት ትሆኚው ዘንድ ወደ አንቺ ልኮናል” ብለው ነገሩአት።
ተነሥታም በግንባርዋ በምድር ወድቃ ሰገደችና፥ “እነሆ፥ እኔ ገረድህ የጌታዬን ሎሌዎች እግር አጥብ ዘንድ አገልጋይ ነኝ” አለች።
አቤግያም ፈጥና ተነሣች፤ በአህያም ላይ ተቀመጠች፤ አምስቱም ገረዶችዋ ተከተሉአት፤ የዳዊትንም መልእክተኞች ተከትላ ሄደች፤ ሚስትም ሆነችው።
ዳዊትም ደግሞ ከኢይዝራኤል አኪናሆምን ወሰደ፤ ሁለቱም ሚስቶቹ ሆኑለት።
ሳኦል ግን የዳዊትን ሚስት ልጁን ሜልኮልን ሀገሩ ሮማ ለነበረው ለያሚስ ልጅ ለፈልጢ ሰጣት።

sections.title: David unto Saul, as it were again, as it was before.

verses.text: And the men of Ziph came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Behold, David is hiding himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon."
And Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having chosen three thousand men from all Israel to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
And Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way; but David abode in the wilderness, and he knew that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
David sent out spies, and Saul, when he came to the place where David was, was certainly informed.

And David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and Saul and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host, were in the place where they had encamped; and Saul lay within the trench, and the people were encamped round about him.
And David said to Abimelech the Hittite and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, "Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?" And Abishai said, "I will go down with you."
So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear was stuck in the ground at his head; but Abner and the people lay round about him.

Then Abishai said to David, "God has delivered your enemy into your hand this day; now therefore let me smite him, I pray you, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time."
And David said to Abishai, "Destroy him not; for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord's anointed, and be guiltless?"

And David said, "As the Lord lives, the Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall go down to battle and perish; but I will not stretch forth my hand against the Lord's anointed."
And the Lord said, "Let my hand be stretched out against him whom I have taken, and now let us go forth with the sword that is by his side and the water that is in his vessel."

And David took the sword that was by Saul's side and the water that was in his vessel, and he returned to his house. No one saw it; no one knew it; no one awoke, for a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen upon them all, and they were all asleep.
And David fled to the wilderness; and he stood upon the mountain, and there was a great distance between them.
And David called to the people and to Abner, the son of Ner, saying, "Abner, do you not answer?" And Abner answered, "Who are you that calls to the king?"

And David said to Abner, "Are you not a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept your lord, the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord, the king. Why then have you not guarded your lord, the king?"

"What you have done is not good; as the Lord lives! You have not kept your lord, whom the Lord has anointed, and death shall be upon you; now look where the king's sword and the water that was by his side are."
And Saul heard the voice of David, and he said, "Is that your voice, my son David?" And David said, "It is my voice, my lord, O king!"
And he said again, "Why does my lord pursue his servant? What have I done? What evil is found in my hand?"

"Now therefore, my lord, O king, hear the words of your servant: If the Lord has stirred you up against me, let Him accept an offering; but if it is the children of men, let them be cursed before the Lord, for they have driven me out this day from sharing in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, 'Go, serve other gods.'"
"Now therefore, do not let my blood fall to the earth before the Lord, for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains."

And Saul said, “I am in distress; my son David! Return, for today my soul is greatly troubled before your eyes, and from henceforth I shall not do you any harm; behold, as I have done, I know very well.”
And David answered, “Behold, the king's army; let one of the mighty men come forth and lead them.”
“Today, the Lord has delivered you into my hand, and I have not lifted my hand against you, for the Lord shall judge each one according to his righteousness and according to his faithfulness.”
“Your soul today is as precious in my sight as my own; thus my soul shall honor the Lord, and may He deliver me from all my troubles.”
And Saul said to David, “My son David! Blessed be you; you shall do what you desire, and you are able to accomplish it.” And David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

sections.title: David among the Philistines.

verses.text: ዳዊትም በልቡ፥ “አንድ ቀን በሳኦል እጅ እሞታለሁ፤ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ምድር ከመሸሸ በቀር የሚሻለኝ የለም፤ ሳኦልም በእስራኤል አውራጃ ሁሉ እኔን መሻት ይተዋል፤ እንዲሁም ከእጁ እድናለሁ” አለ።
ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ስድስቱ መቶ ሰዎች ተነሥተው ወደ ጌት ንጉሥ ወደ አሜህ ልጅ ወደ አንኩስ አለፉ።
ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም እያንዳንዳቸው ከነቤተሰቡ ከአንኩስ ጋር በጌት ተቀመጡ፤ ከዳዊትም ጋር ኢይዝራኤላዊቱ አኪናሆምና የቀርሜሎሳዊው የናባል ሚስት አቤግያ ሁለቱ ሚስቶቹ ነበሩ።
ለሳኦልም ዳዊት ወደ ጌት እንደ ኰበለለ ነገሩት፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ አልፈለገውም።
ዳዊትም አንኩስን፥ “አገልጋይህ በዐይንህ ፊት ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ በዚህ ሀገር ከከተሞችህ በአንዲቱ የምቀመጥበት ስፍራ ስጠኝ፤ ስለ ምን እኔ አገልጋይህ ከአንተ ጋር በንጉሥ ከተማ እቀመጣለሁ?” አለው።።
በዚያም ቀን አንኩስ ሴቄላቅን ሰጠው፤ ስለዚህም ሴቄላቅ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሆነች።
ዳዊትም በፍልስጥኤማውያን ሀገር የተቀመጠበት የዘመን ቍጥር አራት ወር ነበረ።
ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወጥተው በጌሴራውያንና በአማሌቃውያን ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፤ እነዚህንም ቅጽር ባላቸው በጌላምሱርና በአኔቆንጦን እስከ ግብፅ ምድር ድረስ ተቀምጠው አገኙአቸው።
ዳዊትም ሀገሪቱን መታ፤ ወንድም ሆነ፥ ሴትም ሆነ፥ ማንንም በሕይወት አልተወም፤ በጎችንና ላሞችን፥ አህያዎችንና ግመሎችን፥ ልብስንም ማረከ፤ ተመልሶም ወደ አንኩስ መጣ።
አንኩስም ዳዊትን፥ “ዛሬ በማን ላይ ዘመታችሁ?” አለው፤ ዳዊትም፥ “በይሁዳ ደቡብ፥ በያሴሜጋ ደቡብ፥ በቄኔዛውያን ደቡብ ላይ ዘመትን” አለው።

David did thus; for in the days when he dwelt among the Philistines, it was said, "This has been his custom all the days," lest they speak against him. Therefore, David brought forth to his lord any man, whether brother or sister, who had not been alive.
And he said, "Indeed, he has become greatly despised among the people of Israel; therefore, he shall be a servant forever," thus did David believe.
And it came to pass; in those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together to fight against Israel. And Achish said unto David, “Surely, thou and thy men shall go out with me to battle.”
And David said unto Achish, “Now, what dost thou require of thy servant?” And Achish answered David, “In this time, I will make thee my keeper forever.”

sections.title: Saul inquired of the spirit of the dead as one who seeks counsel.

verses.text: ሳሙኤል ግን ሞቶ ነበር፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ አልቅሰውለት ነበር፤ በከተማውም በአርማቴም ቀብረውት ነበር። ሳኦልም መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ከምድር አጥፍቶ ነበር።
ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ተሰብስበው መጡ፤ በሱነምም ሰፈሩ፤ ሳኦልም እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ በጌላቡሄም ሰፈሩ።
ሳኦልም የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ ባየ ጊዜ ፈራ፤ ልቡም እጅግ ተንቀጠቀጠ።
ሳኦልም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ጠየቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሕልም አላሚዎች፥ ወይም በነጋሪዎች፥ ወይም በነቢያት አልመለሰለትም።
ሳኦልም ብላቴኖቹን፥ “ወደ እርስዋ ሄጄ እጠይቅ ዘንድ መናፍስትን የምትጠራ ሴት ፈልጉልኝ” አላቸው፤ ብላቴኖቹም፥ “እነሆ፥ መናፍስትን የምትጠራ አንዲት ሴት በዓይንዶር አለች” አሉት።
ሳኦልም መልኩን ለውጦ፥ ሌላ ልብስም ለብሶ ሄደ፤ ሁለትም ሰዎች ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፤ በሌሊትም ወደ ሴቲቱ መጡ። ሳኦልም፥ “እባክሽ በመናፍስት አምዋርቺልኝ፤ የምልሽንም አስነሽልኝ” አላት።
ሴቲቱም፥ “እነሆ፥ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ከምድር እንዳጠፋ ሳኦል ያደረገውን ታውቃለህ፤ ስለምን እኔን ለማስገደል ለነፍሴ ወጥመድ ታደርጋለህ?” አለችው።
ሳኦልም ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በዚህ ነገር ክፉ አያገኝሽም ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ማለላት።
ሴቲቱም፥ “ማንን ላስነሣልህ?” አለችው፤ እርሱም፥ “ሳሙኤልን አስነሽልኝ” አላት።
ሴቲቱም ሳሙኤልን ባየች ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸች፤ ሴቲቱም ሳኦልን፥ “አንተ ሳኦል ስትሆን ለምን አታለልኸኝ?” ብላ ተናገረችው።
And the king said, "Fear not; for what seest thou?" And she said, "I saw a spirit ascending out of the earth."

And he said, "What form is he of?" And she said, "An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle." And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

And Samuel said to Saul, "Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up?" And Saul answered, "I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do."
And Samuel said, "Why then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?"
And the LORD hath done to him as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbor, even to David.
Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

Moreover, the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and tomorrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, "Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me."
Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength when thou goest on thy way."
But he said, "I will not eat," yet his servants and the woman urged him; and he hearkened to their words, and arose from the ground and sat upon the bed.
And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she made haste and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread.
And she brought it before Saul and before his servants; and they did eat. And they rose up and went away that night.

sections.title: And David returned to Sekelak.

verses.text: And the Philistines gathered all their forces unto Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the fountain which is in Jezreel.
The captains of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish.

And the captains of the Philistines said, "What are these Hebrews doing here?" And Achish said unto the captains of the Philistines, "Is not this David, the servant of Saul, the king of Israel, who hath been with us these days, or these years? And I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day."

But the captains of the Philistines were angry with him; and the captains of the Philistines said unto him, "Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him; and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us; for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? Should it not be with the heads of these men?"
And the women sang as they played, and said, "Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands." And they said, "Is this David not the one?"

And Achish called David, and said unto him, "As the Lord liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day; nevertheless the lords favor thee not."
Now therefore return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines."

And David said unto Achish, "But what have I done? And what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"

And Achish answered and said to David, "I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God; notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, 'He shall not go up with us to the battle.'"

Now therefore rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee; and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart." And they rose up early, and departed at the dawning of the morning.
And David and the people with him arose to go to the land of the Philistines, and they returned to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went out to fight against Israel.

sections.title: And David smote the Amalekites, as he had done.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ሴቄላቅ በገቡ ጊዜ፥ አማሌቃውያን በአዜብ በሰቄላቅም ላይ ዘምተው ነበር፤ ሴቄላቅንም መትተው በእሳት አቃጥለዋት ነበር፥
ሴቶቹንና በውስጥዋም የነበሩትን ሁሉ ከታናሽ እስከ ታላቅ ድረስ ማርከው ነበር፤ ሁሉንም ወስደው መንገዳቸውን ሄዱ እንጂ ሴቶችንም ሆነ ወንዶችን አልገደሉም።
ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወደ ከተማ በመጡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በእሳት ተቃጥላ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም ተማርከው አገኙ።
ዳዊትና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው ለማልቀስ ኀይል እስኪያጡ ድረስ አለቀሱ።
የዳዊትም ሁለቱ ሚስቶቹ ኢይዝራኤላዊቱ አኪናሆምና የቀርሜሎሳዊው የናባል ሚስት የነበረችው አቤግያ ተማርከው ነበር።
ስለ ወንዶችና ስለ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም የሕዝቡ ሁሉ ልብ አዝኖ ነበርና ሕዝቡ ሊወግሩት ስለ ተናገሩ ዳዊት እጅግ ተጨነቀ፤ ዳዊት ግን በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ራሱን አጽናና።
ዳዊትም የአቤሜሌክን ልጅ ካህኑን አብያታርን፥ “ኤፉዱን አቅርብልኝ” አለው፤ አብያታርም ኤፉዱን ለዳዊት አቀረበለት።
ዳዊትም፥ “የእነዚህን ሠራዊት ፍለጋ ልከተልን? አገኛቸዋለሁን?” ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እርሱም፥ “ታገኛቸዋለህና፥ ፈጽመህም ምርኮኞቹን ታድናለህና ፍለጋቸውን ተከተል” ብሎ መለሰለት።
ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ሄዱ፤ እስከ ቦሦር ወንዝ ድረስም መጡ፤ ከእነርሱም የቀሩት በዚያ ተቀመጡ።
ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት አራት መቶ ሰዎች አሳደዱ፤ ሁለቱ መቶ ሰዎች ግን የቦሦር ወንዝን መሻገር ደክመዋልና በኋላ ቀሩ።
And behold, in the wilderness, a certain Egyptian found him and brought him to David; and they gave him bread, and he did eat; and they gave him water to drink.
And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and he did eat; and his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread nor drunk any water for three days and three nights.
And David said unto him, “To whom belongest thou? And whence art thou?” And he said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, for three days agone I fell sick.”
And we were in the field of the Philistines, and on the side of Judah, and in the field of Caleb, and we burned Ziklag with fire,” he said.

And David said, “Wilt thou bring me down to this company?” And he said, “Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.”

And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day; and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels and fled.
And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away; and David rescued his two wives.
And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil nor anything that they had taken to them; David recovered all.
And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, “This is David's spoil.”

And David, being distressed, was pursued by those who were with him; and they came to him at the brook Besor, and there were with him two hundred men. And they were weary and could not follow David; and David came near to the people, and they questioned him concerning their safety.

And those who went with David were all the wicked and worthless men, saying, “These men did not come with us; let them go back to their own homes with their wives and children, for we will not give them anything from the spoils that we have taken.”
But David said, “You shall not do so, my brethren, with what the Lord has given us; for He has preserved us and delivered into our hand the troop that came against us.”
Who will listen to this matter? You shall not be like them, for as they went to battle, so shall be the share of those who stayed with the supplies; they shall share alike.”
From that day forward until this day, it has been a statute and an ordinance for Israel.
And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoils to the elders of Judah, saying, “Behold, a blessing from the enemies of the Lord is come to you.”
To those who were in Bethel, and to those who were in Ramoth, and to those who were in Jattir,
To those who were in Kenites, and to those who were in Hormah, and to those who were in Teman,
To those who were in Chermel, and to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenizzites,
To those who were in Jearim, and to those who were in Beersheba, and to those who were in Nob.
And in Hebron, David and the men who were with him sent to all the men of Judah, who were dwelling in the place where they had returned.

sections.title: The death of Saul and his sons

verses.text: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ፤ ተዋግተውም በጌላቡሄ ተራራ ላይ ወደቁ።
ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን ተከትለው አገኙአቸው። ፍልስጥኤማውያንም የሳኦልን ልጆች ዮናታንንና አሚናዳብን፥ ሜልኪሳንም ገደሉአቸው።
ሰልፍም በሳኦል ላይ ጠነከረ፤ ቀስተኞችም አገኙት፤ ታፋውንም ወጉት።
ሳኦልም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን፥ “እነዚህ ቈላፋን መጥተው እንዳይወጉኝና እንዳይሳለቁብኝ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ውጋኝ” አለ። ጋሻ ጃግሬው ግን እጅግ ፈርቶ ነበርና እንቢ አለ። ሳኦልም ሰይፉን ወስዶ በላዩ ወደቀ።
ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሳኦል እንደ ሞተ ባየ ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በሰይፉ ላይ ወደቀ። ከእርሱም ጋር ሞተ።
በዚያም ቀን ሳኦል ሦስቱም ልጆቹ ጋሻ ጃግሬውም በአንድ ላይ ሞቱ።
በሸለቆውም ማዶና በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩ እስራኤላውያን የእስራኤል ሰዎች እንደ ሸሹ፥ ሳኦልና ልጆቹም እንደ ሞቱ ባዩ ጊዜ ከተሞቹን ለቅቀው ሸሹ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው ተቀመጡባቸው።
በማግሥቱም ፍልስጥኤማውያን የሞቱትን ለመግፈፍ በመጡ ጊዜ ሳኦልና ሦስቱ ልጆቹ በጌላቡሄ ተራራ ላይ ወድቀው አገኙአቸው።
አገላብጠውም የጦር መሣሪያዎችን ገፈፉ፤ በዙሪያቸውም ላሉ ለጣዖታቱና ለሕዝቡ የምሥራች ይነግሩ ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ሀገር ሁሉ ላኩ።
የጦር መሣሪያውንም በአስታሮት መቅደስ ውስጥ አኖሩት። ሬሳውንም በቤትሶም ቅጥር ላይ አንጠለጠሉት።
And the Philistines, when they heard of the deeds of the men of Jabesh, all the warriors arose and went throughout the night.
And they took the head of Saul and the head of his son Jonathan and brought them to the wall of Jabesh; and there they hung them up.
And they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
